Percentages are based on the number of enrolled patients.
The Safety population includes all patients who have received at least one dose of CPX-POM.
The Efficacy population includes all patients who have received at least one dose of CPX-POM, had RECIST measurable disease at
baseline and had at least one other post-baseline tumor assessment.
